title: Data and model supply chain poisoning
interaction: student types each of 7 commands; runner validates and corrects

files.name: pytorch_model.bin
files.note: pickle format - the point of the lab; repo has no safetensors

models.shared_note: Labs 2-8 needing a tiny BERT MUST reuse this exact source ID and cache path so the merged image stores it once.

python_packages.name: torch
python_packages.note: CPU-only. Default PyPI wheel is 554 MB on x86_64 and pulls nvidia-* packages.

python_packages.name: numpy
python_packages.note: Silences torch's 'Failed to initialize NumPy' warning; needed by labs 2+ anyway.

python_packages.name: fickling
python_packages.note: Installed without the [torch] extra, which would drag in torchvision. Steps 6-7.

not_used.name: transformers
not_used.reason: Dropped. v5 is safetensors-first and we only need a state dict. hf_hub_download + torch.load is smaller and clearer to read.
